def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variants
    island_map = {'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    # Fix sex label variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Fix body_mass_g text numbers
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df[df['species'] == 'Adelie']
    df = df.dropna(subset=['island', 'bill_length_mm'])
    result = df.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
